AI Leaders to Brief UN Security Council on Global Security Threats

Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, and Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, are scheduled to brief the United Nations Security Council. France has raised concerns about the threat artificial intelligence poses to children and global security. An outgoing deputy police chief has also warned that AI presents a new national security threat.
